module fsm #(
    parameter s0 = 3'b000,
    parameter s1 = 3'b001,
    parameter s2 = 3'b010,
    parameter s3 = 3'b011,
    parameter s4 = 3'b100,
    parameter s5 = 3'b101
) (
    input IN,
    output reg MATCH,
    input CLK,
    input RST
);


reg [2:0] ST_cr;

always @(posedge CLK or posedge RST) begin
    if (RST) begin
        ST_cr <= s0;
    end else begin
        case (ST_cr)
            s0: begin
                if (IN == 1'b1) begin
                    ST_cr <= s1;
                end else begin
                    ST_cr <= s0;
                end
            end
            s1: begin
                if (IN == 1'b1) begin
                    ST_cr <= s1;
                end else begin
                    ST_cr <= s2;
                end
            end
            s2: begin
                if (IN == 1'b1) begin
                    ST_cr <= s1;
                end else begin
                    ST_cr <= s3;
                end
            end
            s3: begin
                if (IN == 1'b1) begin
                    ST_cr <= s4;
                end else begin
                    ST_cr <= s0;
                end
            end
            s4: begin
                if (IN == 1'b1) begin
                    ST_cr <= s5;
                end else begin
                    ST_cr <= s2;
                end
            end
            s5: begin
                if (IN == 1'b1) begin
                    ST_cr <= s1;
                end else begin
                    ST_cr <= s2;
                end
            end
            default: ST_cr <= s0;
        endcase
    end
end

always @(*) begin
    if (RST) begin
        MATCH = 1'b0;
    end else if (ST_cr == s4 && IN == 1'b1) begin
        MATCH = 1'b1;
    end else begin
        MATCH = 1'b0;
    end
end

endmodule
samples.xml_description:
<module id="fsm">
    <description>Mealy FSM detection circuit that detects a single-bit input IN. When the input is 10011, output MATCH is 1, and MATCH is 0 in other cases. Support for continuous input and loop detection.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="IN">Input signal to the FSM.</input>
        <input id="CLK">Clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="RST">Reset signal to initialize the FSM.</input>
        <output id="MATCH">Output signal indicating a match condition based on the FSM state.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="S0">Initial state.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S1">State after detecting '1'.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S2">State after detecting '10'.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S3">State after detecting '100'.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S4">State after detecting '1001'.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S5">State after detecting '10011'.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="current_state" width_description="[2:0]">Register to hold the current state of the FSM.</reg>
        <reg id="next_state" width_description="[2:0]">Register to hold the next state of the FSM.</reg>
        
        // State transition logic
        <always @(posedge CLK or posedge RST)>
            if (RST) begin
                current_state <= S0;
            end else begin
                current_state <= next_state;
            end
        </always>
        
        // Next state logic
        <always @(*) begin
            case(current_state)
                S0: begin
                    if(IN == 1'b1) begin
                        next_state = S1;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = S0;
                    end
                end
                
                S1: begin
                    if(IN == 1'b0) begin
                        next_state = S2;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = S1;
                    end
                end
                
                S2: begin
                    if(IN == 1'b0) begin
                        next_state = S3;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = S1;
                    end
                end
                
                S3: begin
                    if(IN == 1'b1) begin
                        next_state = S4;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = S0;
                    end
                end
                
                S4: begin
                    if(IN == 1'b1) begin
                        next_state = S5;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = S0;
                    end
                end
                
                S5: begin
                    if(IN == 1'b0) begin
                        next_state = S2;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = S1;
                    end
                end
                
                default: next_state = S0;
            endcase
        end
        
        // Output logic
        <assign MATCH = (current_state == S5 && IN == 1'b1) ? 1'b1 : 1'b0;
    </logic_description>
    
    <implementation>Mealy FSM detection circuit that detects a single-bit input IN. When the input is 10011, output MATCH is 1, and MATCH is 0 in other cases. Support for continuous input and loop detection.</implementation>
</module>
